displayDescription: A copper portal idea grows connections, then a spiral camera zooms through two nested worlds (x1 to x9) to a matched loop framing.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (procedural nested-world lens scene with per-level camera matrices)
HTML/CSS + inline SVG (stationary text, ruler and scale readout layer)
audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, music, sound effects or voice.
limitations: Illustrative procedural 2D scene: depth comes from a log-scale camera transform and value dimming of deeper worlds, not real 3D geometry or physical lighting. The portal glow is a bounded Canvas shadow, not bloom.
Blender was excluded by user instruction. Three.js and PixiJS were not needed because the self-similar vector worlds render cleanly in Canvas 2D.
The loop matches World 1's composition after its connections are built, not the t=0 frame where the connections are still drawing.

Palette is scene-dependent: a dark teal-black lens stage, a blue-grey connection family and a single copper accent for the portal and scale data. These follow the reviewed source lessons (dark value-driven stage, one semantic accent) and copy no source subjects or hues exactly.
Only sampled reference frames were reviewed. Rendering and browser QA are left to the host.
